<!-- Generated by tools/copilot/sync.py from .claude/commands/review.md; edit the source and rerun it. -->
Desktop is reopened. Screenshot the report in its default state (`pbik desktop screenshot --report <Report> --page <display name> --out _snapshots/<page>.png --region 0,0,1920,1080`) and build a side-by-side with the wireframe. If it exits 3 (no Desktop Bridge), ask me for the screenshots by hand (.claude/rules/pbik.md "When the Desktop Bridge is missing").
Check every visual, by its ID, against its done-when line in design/specs/spec.md and against design/checks.md. Also screenshot the empty-case state from design/specs/audit.json (a member with rows but nothing to show) and check every card, small multiple and SVG in it. Do the numbers audit described in .claude/commands/validate.md.
Run the fidelity check when Desktop is open: `python design/scripts/fidelity_check.py --port auto` (add `--assume-saved` only when Desktop was just reopened for this review and nothing was changed in it: Desktop flags a report unsaved on opening). It writes design/reviews/fidelity/fidelity.html (wireframe and Desktop side by side) and fidelity.md (visuals whose position, type or main text differ); look at the screenshot pairs too. Put each difference in review.md as either layout drift (Desktop changed, layout.json didn't) or a wireframe drawing error (a kit issue). If the check exits 3 (Desktop or its bridge not available), don't run it: write "Fidelity check: skipped (Desktop not open)" in review.md and say so in the summary.
On a synthetic or sample-data report, run `python design/scripts/card_space.py <Report> --page <display name> --png _snapshots/<page>.png` for every page with KPI cards: a card with a large empty band (C-10) is a medium finding.
Also write design/reviews/audit.dax: a DAX query file for the DAX query view that returns, for each key value, the expected value recomputed from the raw columns next to the model's measure.
Write the results to design/reviews/review.md as one ranked table: ID, item, severity (high, medium, low), what is wrong, likely cause, fixable or tooling limit. Every finding names the visual ID(s) it is about. Run design/scripts/audit_ids.py and `pbik validate <Report> --layout design/specs/layout.json`. Don't fix anything. Give me a summary under 10 lines.
